publication_rule: Every public claim must be atomic, sourced, bounded, reviewable and correctable. Unknowns remain explicit.

claims.subject: Betrieb Mucke
claims.claim: Tönnies Livestock publicly profiles Betrieb Mucke and describes a long-term collaboration; the farm describes arrangements including offtake contracts.
claims.boundary: This does not prove that animals from Betrieb Mucke went to a particular slaughterhouse, on a particular date, or into a particular product.
claims.falsification_condition: A correction from either party or authoritative records showing the described relationship is inaccurate or no longer valid.

claims.subject: Betrieb Mertens
claims.claim: Tönnies Livestock publicly profiles Betrieb Mertens as a partner farm involved in piglet rearing and pig finishing.
claims.boundary: This does not prove a shipment, a slaughterhouse destination or a product destination.
claims.falsification_condition: A correction from either party or authoritative records showing the described relationship is inaccurate.

claims.subject: Tönnies Livestock GmbH
claims.claim: Tönnies Livestock describes itself as part of the wider Tönnies system and as a livestock-marketing company based in Rheda-Wiedenbrück.
claims.boundary: Group connection does not collapse distinct legal entities and does not prove the destination of any particular animal.
claims.falsification_condition: Current corporate records or company materials showing the entity is no longer part of the group.

claims.subject: Premium Food Group
claims.claim: Premium Food Group describes Rheda-Wiedenbrück as its headquarters and a historic slaughter and processing location.
claims.boundary: This does not prove that either named partner farm supplied this facility.
claims.falsification_condition: Current official material showing operator status has changed.

claims.subject: Premium Food Group
claims.claim: Premium Food Group states that the historic pig slaughterhouse in Weißenfels was taken over by the group in 1990.
claims.boundary: This does not prove that either named partner farm supplied this facility.
claims.falsification_condition: Current official material showing operator status has changed.

claims.subject: PFG Central Services GmbH & Co. KG
claims.claim: A group-linked central-services entity is registered in the German Bundestag Lobbyregister with a 2026 initiative concerning the Tierhaltungskennzeichnungsgesetz.
claims.boundary: Registered lobbying activity is not proof that the company caused, bought or controlled a policy outcome.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official register record showing the attribution is wrong.

claims.subject: BMEL
claims.claim: BfR identifies BMEL as the funding body for the KontRed research project under grant reference 281C104B18.
claims.boundary: This project-level funding claim does not by itself identify how much money any individual external partner received.
claims.falsification_condition: An authoritative project or funder correction.

claims.subject: Tönnies Lebensmittel GmbH & Co. KG
claims.claim: BfR names Tönnies Lebensmittel GmbH & Co. KG as an external partner in the BMEL-funded KontRed project.
claims.boundary: Consortium participation is not a claim that a specific subsidy amount was paid to this company.
claims.falsification_condition: An authoritative project record showing the entity was not an external partner.

claims.subject: Premium Food Group Pork division
claims.claim: Premium Food Group reports that its Pork division has a market share of more than 30 percent in Germany and describes it as the German pork market leader.
claims.boundary: This is a company-reported market-share signal; it is not an estimate of animal suffering or legal responsibility.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer authoritative market-share source or company correction that materially changes the figure.

claims.subject: Premium Food Group
claims.claim: Premium Food Group reports worldwide turnover of €8.0 billion for 2024.
claims.source_title: Premium Food Group — Homepage / Facts and figures
claims.boundary: Turnover is a scale indicator and does not by itself measure animal impact, profit or market power.
claims.falsification_condition: Restated company accounts or an authoritative correction.

claims.subject: Premium Food Group
claims.claim: Premium Food Group reports that €4.1 billion of its 2024 turnover was generated in Germany.
claims.source_title: Premium Food Group — Homepage / Facts and figures
claims.boundary: This does not identify revenue by species, product, customer or retailer.
claims.falsification_condition: Restated company accounts or an authoritative correction.

claims.subject: Premium Food Group
claims.claim: Premium Food Group states that it produces and markets meat and sausage products, vegetarian products, convenience foods and other food and by-product categories.
claims.boundary: This broad portfolio description does not establish the share of revenue, volume or animal impact attributable to any category.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company portfolio disclosure that materially contradicts this description.

claims.subject: Tönnies Group holding level
claims.claim: The company announced that the Tönnies Group would operate at holding level as Premium Food Group from the beginning of 2025, while the Tönnies name would remain focused on meat production.
claims.source_title: Premium Food Group — Tönnies Holding firmiert ab 1. Januar 2025 als Premium Food Group
claims.boundary: The holding-level name change does not mean every legal entity or the Tönnies meat brand was renamed or ceased to exist.
claims.falsification_condition: Corporate filings or an official correction showing a materially different effective structure.

claims.subject: Tönnies Livestock
claims.claim: Tönnies Livestock states that it supports the marketing of piglets, pigs and slaughter sows and uses a wider EU network to reach multiple target markets.
claims.boundary: This supports the intermediary role but does not identify the destination slaughterhouse for a named farm or shipment.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company correction showing these activities or network description no longer apply.

claims.subject: PFG Central Services GmbH & Co. KG
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister reports annual lobbying expenditure of €140,001 to €150,000 for PFG Central Services GmbH & Co. KG for financial year 2024.
claims.boundary: Lobbying expenditure is not proof of policy influence, causation or improper conduct.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official Lobbyregister record.

claims.subject: Bundeskartellamt
claims.claim: On 12 June 2025 the Bundeskartellamt announced that it had prohibited Tönnies International Management GmbH from acquiring several Vion companies and assets, including slaughterhouses in Buchloe, Crailsheim and Waldkraiburg.
claims.source_title: Bundeskartellamt — Übernahme von Vion-Schlachthöfen durch Tönnies
claims.boundary: A prohibited proposed acquisition is not ownership of the target facilities. The authority noted that the decision was not yet final at the time of publication.
claims.falsification_condition: A later final decision, successful appeal or transaction outcome superseding the 12 June 2025 procedural status.

claims.subject: Tönnies
claims.claim: In its June 2025 merger-control notice, the Bundeskartellamt stated that Tönnies already operated slaughterhouses in Altenburg and Kempten for cattle and Weißenfels for pigs.
claims.source_title: Bundeskartellamt — Übernahme von Vion-Schlachthöfen durch Tönnies
claims.boundary: This authority statement identifies existing facilities but does not connect either named partner farm to those sites.
claims.falsification_condition: A later official record showing operator status changed.

claims.subject: Westfleisch SCE mbH
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that more than 5,200 farmers are members and owners of the cooperative.
claims.boundary: Membership does not prove that every member supplies every Westfleisch facility or supplies continuously.
claims.falsification_condition: A current cooperative disclosure with a materially different member count or structure.

claims.subject: Westfleisch farmer members
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that its farmer members produce pigs, cattle and calves through cooperation contracts.
claims.boundary: This is a relationship class, not a list of named farms, shipments or slaughter destinations.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or contractual disclosure materially changing this relationship model.

claims.subject: Westfleisch
claims.object: five meat centres in northwest Germany
claims.claim: Westfleisch describes five meat centres: cattle-focused operations in Lübbecke and Bakum and pig operations in Hamm, Oer-Erkenschwick and Coesfeld.
claims.boundary: Facility type does not establish the origin farm of a particular animal or product destination.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or regulatory facility record showing a changed site portfolio or function.

claims.subject: Regional family farms around Coesfeld
claims.claim: Westfleisch states that several hundred regional family farms, many of them cooperative members, have supplied pigs to their marketing company in the Coesfeld context, in many cases for decades.
claims.boundary: The source describes a regional supplier population but does not name each farm or establish a current shipment from a specific farm.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company correction or authoritative supply-chain record materially contradicting the described Coesfeld relationship.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that the group consists of more than 45 subsidiary companies.
claims.boundary: A group-level count does not identify each legal entity, ownership percentage or current operating role.
claims.falsification_condition: A current corporate disclosure with a materially different group structure.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe reports group turnover of approximately €4.1 billion for financial year 2024/2025.
claims.boundary: Turnover is a scale indicator and does not quantify animal impact, profit or market share.
claims.falsification_condition: Restated company accounts or an authoritative correction.

claims.subject: PHW-Gruppe contract farmers
claims.claim: PHW-Gruppe states that approximately 1,000 independent contract farmers across Germany raise chickens, turkeys and ducks for the group within its vertically integrated poultry system.
claims.boundary: This does not identify a named contract farm, a particular slaughter facility, shipment or branded product path.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or authoritative supply-chain disclosure materially changing the stated contract-farmer model or count.

claims.subject: Betrieb Mucke
claims.claim: The exact slaughterhouse destination for the named Betrieb Mucke relationship has not yet been established from a public primary source.
claims.boundary: No destination is inferred from geography, group membership or plausibility.
claims.falsification_condition: A shipment, audit, supplier-programme, veterinary or facility source explicitly identifying the destination.
